purpose: The customer stack: a .NET 8 billing backend in backend/ whose solution also holds a Windows Forms admin tool (net8.0-windows), next to a native iOS app in ios/ (Xcode, CocoaPods, Swift packages). The backend is assessed in the .NET 8 SDK image with its restore, build and test aimed at the test project, so the admin tool never runs and can't fail it; it reaches Level 2 like dotnet-xunit. The admin tool is its own component with its own share, listed as needing Windows, and ios/ is a component listed as needing macOS with Xcode, never a mobile platform shell, since no React Native or Flutter project holds it.
